(Fā'ida)

Know that continual remembrance of God on the road, at home, in the settled areas and while travelling, and in every place, multiplies the witnesses for the servant on the Day of Resurrection. For the place, the house, the mountain and the earth will bear witness for the one who remembers God on the Day of Resurrection. God the Exalted says: ﴿When the earth is shaken with its (final) shaking (1), and the earth brings forth its burdens (2), and man says, "What is wrong with it?" (3), that Day it will report its news (4), because your Lord has inspired it (5).﴾

Al-Tirmidhi related in his Jami' from the narration of Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayra, who said:

"The Messenger of God (ﷺ) recited this verse: ﴿That Day it will report its news﴾, then said: Do you know what its news is?

They said: God and His Messenger know best. He said: Its news is that it will bear witness against every servant or handmaid for what they did upon its surface, saying: 'On such-and-such a day he did such-and-such.'"

Al-Tirmidhi said: This is a hasan sahih hadith.

The one who remembers God, the Mighty and Majestic, in all places multiplies its witnesses, and perhaps they, or most of them, will accept him on the Day of Resurrection, the Day when the witnesses stand and the testimonies are given, so he will rejoice and be delighted by their testimony.

(Faṣl)

Since His wisdom, blessed and exalted, required that He make the earth to have plains, rough terrain, mountains and sand, so that everything in it may benefit His creatures and what He created it for may be achieved, and since the earth was in this position, it followed that it became like a mother who carries in her womb all kinds of offspring of every type, and then brings forth to people and animals from that what her Lord has permitted her to bring forth, either with their knowledge or without it.

Then what has come out of it is returned to it.

He, glorified be He, made it a kafat (a container that gathers): for the living while they are upon its surface, and when they die, it keeps them in its womb. Thus it is a kafat for them, gathering them upon its surface while alive and in its womb when dead.

When the appointed time comes, and the earth is burdened by its load, the time of birth arrives and the pangs draw near, its Lord and Creator inspires it to deliver its burden and bring out its loads, so it brings people out from its womb onto its surface, saying: "My Lord, this is what You entrusted to me." It also brings out its treasures by His permission, the Exalted, and then reports its news, and bears witness against its sons for what they did upon its surface, good and evil.

The Prophet ﷺ called this verse "comprehensive and unique": ﴿So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it (7), and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it (8)﴾.

That is, it is comprehensive and unique in its category.

It was narrated that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about donkeys, and he said: "Nothing was revealed to me concerning them except this comprehensive and unique verse: ﴿So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it (7), and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it (8)﴾."
